themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interpret findings, and even generate new hypotheses.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers tools and techniques where AI assists developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a wide array of AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Details AI applications in automating testing processes, including software testing, security testing, and quality assurance.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is reshaping jobs, creating new roles, and impacting employment trends across various industries.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques for condensing large amounts of text, research papers, or discussions into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze and understand user sentiment from reviews, feedback, and social media.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Highlights the use of AI in the design process, including generating design concepts, prototypes, and user interface elements.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being used to analyze qualitative data, conduct interviews, and extract insights from unstructured text.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of simulated users or personas for testing and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
